messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The latest payment batch is not appearing in the supplier ledger.
  quote: I’m trying to figure out why the latest payment batch didn’t reflect in our supplier ledger
- problem: The user is unable to find the specific supplier invoices needed to reconcile a payment batch within the system.
  quote: I’m trying to reconcile the latest payment batch with our suppliers’ invoices but can’t locate the matching documents in the system.
- problem: The user is experiencing an issue where uploaded claim documents are not automatically assigned to the correct supplier tasks.
  quote: I’m trying to figure out why my latest batch of claims documents didn’t auto-assign to the right supplier tasks.
